exposure: Skin-to-skin contact (SSC) during the first hour of life
cohort: The study included 362 infants whose medical records, dating from 2016 to 2022, were reviewed, categorized into cases with skin-to-skin contact and controls without.
finding: Infants who received skin-to-skin contact during the first hour of life were significantly more likely to receive exclusive breastfeeding at both 3 and 6 months of age.
